items.label: Smalltown Supersound
items.context: Norwegian-Mexican producer Carmen Villain continues her relationship with Smalltown Supersound, reassembling new and archived flute, trumpet and clarinet recordings around the mutability of memory. items.label: Quindi Records
items.genre: Digital folk, experimental electronics, ritual ambient
items.context: Baldruin is Wiesbaden musician Johannes Schebler, whose cassette-era catalogue connects with a wider German experimental-folk network.
